# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 91 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 91 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_091_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 8

**1** "The ninth mountain which was utterly desert and had serpents — these are those who believed, but many were stained with various kinds of sins; they were neither consistent in repentance, nor with the saints. **2** Therefore many of them are hollow, for having committed many sins they are empty; some of them never repented at all. **3** You saw the serpents? These are their sins that were embedded in them; they devoured each other and destroyed one another. For such people their very lives destroy themselves and their households." **4** "But the tenth mountain that had great trees and was shaded all around, and under the trees lay cattle resting and ruminating — these are those who believed and are very blessed, who never stray from God; they always abide in him with joy, meditating on the Lord and his truth; they have deep roots in God." **5** "Now the eleventh mountain where the trees were full of various fruits — these are those who suffered for the sake of the name of the Lord, and gladly and cheerfully endured all affliction, giving up their own souls." **6** "But the twelfth mountain — white — these are the infants and those whose souls are clean, who never had an evil thought in their hearts, never knew what wickedness was, but always remained in innocence." **7** "For these reasons, then, the mountains are different and varied; because these peoples differ from each other; and for each of them there was appointed a specific kind of repentance, so that whoever among them repents shall live to God — if they repent before the tower is finished. **8** But if the tower is finished before they repent, they shall not have a place in the tower; only those who are fitted in before the tower is completed shall have a place in it."

---

*EMET: mountain 12 (white = innocent infants) forms a perfect bookend with mountain 1 (black = apostasy). The tower's completion signals the end of the repentance window.*
